description:
During epic 6dc81018 wave work on 2026-08-19, a cargo-ci run on gf2-sim recorded `gpu::awgn` failures that vanished on immediate re-run of the identical tree: `test_gpu_awgn_matches_cpu_within_1_ulp` died with SIGABRT and `test_gpu_box_muller_within_1_ulp_over_1024_frames` timed out. Both passed on the re-run, with the GPU observed at 0 % use. The occurrence cost one false-red CI cycle; the session's operating rule became "re-run once before treating a red `gpu::awgn` as a regression", which contains the cost but leaves the defect unexplained.

Issue `10071e51` records the adjacent family member: a SIGABRT on `test_gpu_chacha_raw_words_full_range_byte_identical` plus the same box-muller timeout under parallel gate load, with an amdgpu gfxhub page fault and runlist-oversubscription warnings in the kernel log. This observation differs in the failing test (`test_gpu_awgn_matches_cpu_within_1_ulp`) and carries no recorded load coupling; whether it is the same underlying defect is undetermined.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The failure mode is reproduced under a recorded procedure, or a bounded number of recorded attempts falsifies easy reproduction; either way the attempt names the tree, the test invocation, and the concurrent load observed.
- [hard] REQ-02: The relation to `10071e51`'s fault family is adjudicated in the record: the same underlying defect consolidates the two issues, a distinct one keeps both with the distinction stated.
title: gf2-sim gpu::awgn tests fail transiently on a quiet host and pass on identical re-run
